note: Metrics are human-observed estimates from Founder screenshots embedded in session. Exact pixel metrics require preserved image files or deterministic runtime recaptures.

subject_occupancy.assessment: unstable; large clipped overhead subject and small distant relics both present

ui_legibility.assessment: readable but visually primitive and weakly integrated

artistic_diagnosis.lighting: Emissive cores and colored floor wash carry most readability; scene lacks motivated fill, rim/separation, midtone environment, and controlled value script.
artistic_diagnosis.composition: Primary object clips top frame; important forms sit high/left while center/lower frame is mostly empty black or flat floor. Depth cues weak.
artistic_diagnosis.environment: Space reads as test chamber with checker floor, not dying reliquary location. No architecture, history, scale, pathing, or landmarks.
artistic_diagnosis.materials: Relics read as black silhouettes with orange discs. Surface roughness, edge highlights, patina, soot, heat discoloration, glass/metal response not visible.
artistic_diagnosis.state_feedback: States read mostly as yellow/gold vs red illumination; pulse timing and safe window are not self-teaching from screenshots.
artistic_diagnosis.vfx: Runtime plumbing works, but visual effect language lacks shape, timing, layering, and energy sophistication in human evidence.
artistic_diagnosis.hud: Functional debug-like text lacks Ashwake canon, ritual/progression language, state-responsive design, and objective teaching hierarchy.

root_cause_summary: Automation verified assets, packaged execution, and structured runtime markers, but lacked independent creative maturity gates and human-screenshot perceptual/artistic review before quality promotion.
required_foundry_changes: separate engineering maturity from creative maturity and fidelity reliability
require human/specialist visual evidence before creative quality promotion
add hard blockers for severe black crush, primitive environments, clipped primary subject, and generic HUD
add before/after visual regression captures for Ashwake repair
add discipline-specific review gates for lighting, environment, material, state feedback, VFX, animation, audio, UI, and game feel
